data.one_liner: Flutter widget that arranges children in a flexible wrap layout with spacing and RTL support.
data.what_it_does: FlexibleWrap is a custom Flutter layout widget that automatically wraps its children onto the next line based on available space, while expanding items to distribute available space evenly. It supports customizable horizontal and vertical spacing, and right-to-left (RTL) text directions.
use_when: You need a wrap layout that expands items to fill available space in a row.
You require right-to-left (RTL) direction support for wrapped items.
You are building uniform grid-like layouts such as product cards or image galleries.
avoid_when: You have items with varying widths (only same-width items are currently fully supported).
You require a builder pattern for performance with massive lists (currently uses children instead).
strengths: Automatic space distribution across wrapped items
Customizable horizontal spacing and run spacing
weaknesses: Does not currently support items with different widths
Does not support a builder pattern for large data sets
Height direction layout is not supported yet
data.minimal_example:
FlexibleWrap(
  spacing: 12.0,
  runSpacing: 12.0,
  children: [
    Container(height: 100, width: 300, color: Colors.blue),
    Container(height: 100, width: 300, color: Colors.blue),
  ],
)
